shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.description: Attack. On a hit the target makes a Defense save or is stunned (loses its next turn).

poison_arrow.name: Poison Arrow
poison_arrow.description: Attack. On a hit the target makes a Defense save or is poisoned (1 damage a turn for 3 turns).

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: No attack roll: every monster makes a Speed save. Fail: full damage and burning (2 a turn for 2 turns). Pass: half damage.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.description: Two attacks this turn, each at -2 to hit.

iron_guard.name: Iron Guard
iron_guard.description: No attack. You gain Shield 6: it blocks the next 6 damage.

aimed_shot.name: Aimed Shot
aimed_shot.description: Attack with advantage (roll two d20, keep the higher). +1d6 damage on a hit.

frost_bolt.name: Frost Bolt
frost_bolt.description: Attack. On a hit the target makes a Speed save or is frozen (stunned: loses its next turn).

uppercut.name: Uppercut
uppercut.description: Attack at -2 to hit, +1d8 damage on a hit.
